title: INCEPTION group claims theft of Burger King customer data from Restaurant Brands International (unconfirmed claim)
date_note: Escudo Digital (27 Nov) says the listing appeared between Wednesday night and early Thursday (26 Nov).
place: Restaurant Brands International (headquarters not stated in source)
geo_basis: no place stated in the source
summary: Escudo Digital reports that the extortion group INCEPTION posted a listing on its leak portal claiming 234 GB of data from Restaurant Brands International, including 126,038 unique U.S. Burger King customer records. It says the group set a 48-hour deadline, that RBI has issued no official statement and that no evidence of authenticity was provided.
plain: A group claims it stole Burger King customer data and threatens to leak it. The report says the company has not commented and no proof has been shown.
exec: An extortion group claims data of 126,038 U.S. Burger King customers; Restaurant Brands International has issued no official statement, per Escudo Digital.

validation.note: Only Escudo Digital read; the company has not confirmed per that article.

evidence.quote: 126.038 registros únicos de clientes de Burger King en EE.UU.
exfiltrado 234 GB de información confidencial distribuidos en más de 800.000 archivos.
